limitations: All decoded figures are display normalizations of raw GPU data, not re-renders.
HDR figures use a per-image 99th-percentile linear scale plus Reinhard c/(1+c); they are not comparable radiometrically with the SDR reference PNG or with each other without the raw files.
Scene render targets are natively 1280x888 with 168 black padding rows; the content region is the top 1280x720. Figures are written at native 1280x888 and are not resized.
GBuffer figures are valid only because r.Substrate=0 (legacy GBuffer path) was the runtime value.

Lumen reflection trace/resolve resources are tile/ray buffers, not screen-space images: TraceRadiance contains only traced texels and ResolvedSpecularIndirect contains packed tiles with a finite-max sentinel for empty entries. The decoded figures preserve that layout; the composed result is visible in scene-color-after-indirect.
note: source_raw_file values are relative to the external raw dump and are not present in this package.
